title: cmake-fmt Configuration
description: Configuration schema for cmake-fmt formatter. Supports both TOML and YAML formats. For TOML validation in VS Code, configure the Even Better TOML extension (tamasfe.even-better-toml) with evenBetterToml.schema.associations in workspace settings. YAML validation is automatically enabled for .cmake-fmt.yaml and .cmake-fmt.yml files.

disable_format.description: Completely skip formatting and return input unchanged. Place a config with disable_format = true in a subdirectory to exclude that subtree from formatting.

max_line_length.description: Maximum line length before wrapping. Set to 0 for unlimited (never wrap).

use_tabs.description: Use tabs instead of spaces for indentation

command_case.description: Builtin command name casing transformation. 'preserve' keeps original casing unchanged (alias: 'leave').

user_command_case.description: User-defined command name casing. 'infer' analyzes function()/macro() definitions to determine casing. 'preserve' keeps original casing unchanged (alias: 'leave').

line_ending.description: Line ending style. 'auto' detects from input (majority wins, defaults to LF).

closing_style.description: Block closer argument handling. 'preserve' keeps arguments as-is (alias: 'leave'), 'remove' strips them (modernize), 'force' adds them to match openers.

force_break_keywords.description: Force keyword-aware commands to use multiline layout regardless of line length

collapse_empty_flags.description: Collapse consecutive no-argument flags onto the same line as preceding positional arguments. When true (default), flags like REQUIRED or STATIC stay inline. When false, each flag gets its own indented line.

inline_single_keyword.description: When true and a keyword command has only one keyword section, keep the keyword on the same line as the command arguments and single-indent values instead of double-indenting.

control_flow_space_before_paren.description: Insert a space before '(' in control flow and block statements (if, else, endif, foreach, while, function, macro, block, etc.). Regular commands like set() and message() are not affected.

space_between_command_parens.description: Insert a space inside command parentheses. Single-line: set( VAR value ). Multiline: space after ( on first line, closing ) at normal indentation.

indent_closing_paren.description: Indent the closing parenthesis by one level in multiline commands. Can be combined with space_between_command_parens.

final_newline.description: Final newline handling. 'preserve' keeps original file's trailing newline state (alias: 'leave'), 'remove' strips trailing newline, 'force' ensures file ends with newline. Also accepts true (=force) and false (=remove) for backward compatibility.

comment_style.description: Comment whitespace normalization style. 'preserve' keeps original whitespace after # unchanged (alias: 'leave'), 'hash_space' normalizes to '# text', 'hash_no_space' normalizes to '#text'.

source_grouping.description: Source file grouping mode for .h/.cpp pairs. 'none' puts each file on its own line, 'headers_first' and 'sources_first' group pairs on the same line.

sort_sources.description: Auto-sort filenames in set/add_executable/add_library/target_sources commands. 'none' preserves original order, 'alphabetical' sorts case-insensitively. Use '# cmake-fmt: no-sort' to disable for a single statement.

root.description: Stop searching for configuration files in parent directories. When true, this config file is the root configuration — no ancestor configs are inherited.

grammar_files.description: External grammar file paths to import. Paths can be relative to config file or absolute.

command_grammars.description: Manual command grammar definitions. Map of command name to grammar configuration.

options.description: Flag keywords (no values consumed, e.g., REQUIRED, OPTIONAL)

one_value_keywords.description: Single-value keywords (consumes exactly one value, e.g., VERSION, DESTINATION)

multi_value_keywords.description: Multi-value keywords (consumes values until next keyword, e.g., FILES, TARGETS)

pair_value_keywords.description: Pair-value keywords (consumes alternating key/value pairs, e.g., PROPERTIES)

bin_pack_keywords.description: Bin-pack keywords (packs values to fill lines, e.g., SOURCES for compact lists)

sortable_keywords.description: Keywords whose values are an unordered list, so sort_sources and source_grouping may reorder them (e.g., SOURCES). Keywords not listed here are never reordered.

sortable_positional.description: Whether the command's keyword-less arguments are an unordered file list, as in set(VAR a.cpp b.cpp). The list's identifying name is never sorted, and values must look like source files - flag and library shapes are left alone.
